original_card.question: Can one uncovered interface implication be formalized with exact caller and certificate bindings?
methods: Formalize a missing boundary lemma identified by the selected review.
Audit a formal theorem-to-certificate binding independently.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State the exact formalized proposition and remaining assumptions; avoid duplicate arithmetic formalizations already present.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one missing statement with quantified hypotheses, actual caller and existing coverage. A compact-switch lemma is a candidate only after its mathematical contract is reviewed. Establish a bounded proof plan before a separately budgeted proof-assistant build; do not rerun large Lean jobs as orientation.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A missing interface proof can reduce the conditional gap even if it does not change kappa.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one formal lemma or one theorem-to-certificate binding.
scope_change_triggers: Formalizing already-covered arithmetic and claiming the full multiplication theorem.

existing_checks.remaining: Exact theorem-to-caller binding and genuinely uncovered interface lemmas.
Uniform algorithmic implications, not another endpoint digit.

existing_checks.scope: PR #4100: compact-switch formalization proposed as future validation.
existing_checks.remaining: Audit the statement and assumptions before a formal proof campaign.

actual_scope: Prove a complete-register Euclidean rounding-error guard for the PR5339 detector and construct a strict smaller-grid fixture, holding its coarse endpoint separator fixed.
scope_change_reason: This is a new quantitative written proof and exact finite corroboration for an error interface. It is not a proof-kernel formalization or an audit of predecessor mathematics.
bottleneck_link: Scoped precision side result: exact orthogonal calls need not multiply the magnitude bound by the path dimension. Source/native binding and a complete physical bill are still required before any supplier or kappa consequence.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved and exactly corroborated smaller sufficient grid; package it without extending the research.
evidence: PROOF.md proves the complete-grammar error guard; verify.py prints PASS_EUCLIDEAN_ORTHOGONAL_DETECTOR with 1,218 program/input cases, 9,048 prefix banks, 14 invalid and four semantic controls, and literal 228-to-182-bit executions. The generated stdout receipt binds all eight package files.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Can a native-compatible orthogonal witness use this guard with a fully charged caller?

open_questions.first_step: Pin one caller, its real orthogonal operators, exact input grid and radius; apply the guard and count preparation, arithmetic, movement and restoration.
open_questions.blocked_by: No native-compatible source binding, physical bill or selected caller is supplied.

open_questions.blocked_by: No optimal-norm or least-precision claim is proved here.

overlap.distinct_from: PR5941 changes per-matrix separation denominators; this work holds the separator fixed and changes accumulated rounding amplification.
overlap.limits: Live open/account lists, active Discussions, recent handoffs, main README and merged/general-form searches checked. Cached scan and sparse historical notes have explicitly limited coverage; unpublished work and arbitrary diffs are not covered.
